owner.description: Maintainers of the keystone-pipeline repository; corrections go through its issues.

domains.sources: External inputs as fetched (GH Archive hourly files, OSV zips).
domains.activity: Repository activity derived from GH Archive (silver events, rollups, repository facts).
domains.vulnerabilities: OSV advisories and the packages they affect.
domains.packages: Packages and their mapping to repositories.
domains.operations: How the pipeline itself ran (metrics, lineage, quality).

classifications.public: Repository- or package-level facts; safe to publish.
classifications.pseudonymous: Salted keys of accounts (ADR-019); internal only, never published.
classifications.internal: Pipeline-internal (quarantine, staging); no personal data, not published.

datasets.title: GH Archive hourly file
datasets.description: One gzipped JSON-lines file per UTC hour of public GitHub events (data.gharchive.org). Fetched politely, verified by MD5 and SHA-256, parsed and deleted; never republished.

datasets.title: OSV ecosystem zip
datasets.description: All OSV records of one ecosystem (osv.dev, CC BY 4.0), fetched conditionally.

datasets.title: Silver GH Archive events
datasets.description: One row per GH Archive event; repository facts and salted actor keys only.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the verified source file (manifest).

columns.name: fetched_at
columns.description: When the source file was fetched (UTC).

columns.name: source_line
columns.description: 1-based line number of the record in the source file.

columns.name: era
columns.description: Schema era of the source file (E0 to E3, docs/era-map.md).

columns.name: period
columns.description: Completeness period of the source hour (config/sources.yml, ADR-012).

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: GitHub event id; absent in E1 (Timeline API has no event ids).

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: GitHub event type, for example PushEvent.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Event time normalised to UTC (E1 carries Pacific offsets in the source).

columns.name: created_at_offset_min
columns.description: UTC offset of the original created_at string, in minutes (E1 -420/-480).

columns.name: actor_key
columns.description: Salted HMAC-SHA256 (first 32 hex) of the actor's account id, or of the lower-cased login in E1. Never a login.

columns.name: actor_key_kind
columns.description: What actor_key hashes, `id` or `login` (E1 only, ADR-013).

columns.name: actor_is_bot
columns.description: Actor login ends in `[bot]` or is in config/bots.yml.

columns.name: repo_id
columns.description: GitHub repository id; absent in E1 2012 and for some E0 events.

columns.name: repo_name
columns.description: Repository full name `owner/name` at event time.

columns.name: number
columns.description: Pull request or issue number, when the payload has one.

columns.name: ref
columns.description: Git ref of a push, create or delete.

columns.name: push_before
columns.description: Push previous head SHA (E2 and E3).

columns.name: push_size
columns.description: Commits in the push (absent after the payload trim, 2025-10-08 16:59:22Z).

columns.name: push_distinct_size
columns.description: Distinct commits in the push (E2 only).

columns.name: payload_repository_id
columns.description: Payload repository id of a push (late E2 and E3).

columns.name: pr_merged
columns.description: PullRequestEvent merged flag (E1 and E2 only).

columns.name: pr_created_at
columns.description: Pull request creation time, UTC (E1 and E2).

columns.name: pr_merged_at
columns.description: Pull request merge time, UTC (E1 and E2).

columns.name: pr_closed_at
columns.description: Pull request close time, UTC (E1 and E2).

columns.name: pr_author_key
columns.description: Salted key of the pull request author, same kind as actor_key.

columns.name: issue_id
columns.description: Issue id of an IssuesEvent or IssueCommentEvent.

columns.name: issue_created_at
columns.description: Issue creation time, UTC (E2 and E3).

columns.name: issue_closed_at
columns.description: Issue close time, UTC (E2 and E3).

columns.name: issue_author_key
columns.description: Salted key of the issue author, same kind as actor_key.

columns.name: issue_is_pr
columns.description: The issue is a pull request (E2 and E3).

columns.name: comment_created_at
columns.description: Comment creation time, UTC (E2 and E3).
